title: Review snapshots thoughtfully
summary: A snapshot stores an expected structure. Review changes instead of accepting a new snapshot blindly.
introduction: A snapshot stores an expected structure. Review changes instead of accepting a new snapshot blindly. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.

blocks.text: The test checks a small saved object shape. A changed title should cause a review.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Describe when a changed snapshot would be a bug.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Updating every snapshot without reading it can approve a mistake.
For more detail later, use this [Jest further reading](https://jestjs.io/docs/getting-started).
